default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1198.title: Three soldiers / three crows
E-1198.hypothesis: Consecutive full-bodied bars each closing beyond the last show one side taking every auction; late counter-traders must cover or capitulate, so the push continues.

E-1199.title: Highest-close channel break with volume
E-1199.hypothesis: A close (not a wick) beyond every close of the last window is accepted value; with normal-or-higher volume the stops and breakout orders behind it feed the move.

E-1200.title: Detrended price oscillator extreme fade
E-1200.hypothesis: Price far from a lagged moving average (cycle-removed) in units of its own dispersion is an over-extension that liquidity providers fade.

E-1201.title: OBV leads price
E-1201.hypothesis: When on-balance volume makes a new window extreme while price has not, informed flow is ahead of price and the close should catch up.

E-1202.title: Trend intensity index threshold cross
E-1202.hypothesis: When almost every recent close sits on one side of a slow average, persistent one-sided participation is under way; the cross into that state marks trend onset.

E-1203.title: VWAP sigma-band break follow
E-1203.hypothesis: A close more than k session-deviations from VWAP is a value migration, not a stretch; institutions chasing VWAP-benchmarked orders keep buying/selling into it.

E-1204.title: Bollinger close-outside follow
E-1204.hypothesis: A close outside a volatility band built from prior bars signals range expansion; the breakout is followed by trend-chasers.

E-1205.title: Dollar-beta residual overshoot fade
E-1205.hypothesis: The part of the index move not explained by the rolling dollar beta is idiosyncratic noise from order flow, not macro; it tends to revert.

E-1206.title: Largest-bar open retraced
E-1206.hypothesis: When price fully retraces the biggest recent impulse bar back through its open, those who chased it are trapped and their exits push the retrace on.

E-1207.title: Single-bar EMA slice follow
E-1207.hypothesis: A strong bar that opens on one side of the EMA and closes on the other shows decisive control change in one auction; follow it.
